type get_molecule_profile = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.

// Target pH for ionization/logD estimation (default: 7.4).

// SMILES string of the molecule.

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// Find the most similar molecules from the training set using task-aware embeddings. Returns K nearest neighbors with their labels and functional groups, plus the closest molecule with the opposite label for contrastive SAR reasoning. k?: number

// SMILES string of the molecule.

type get_scaffold = (_: {

smiles: string

// SMILES string (may contain salts).
smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
